summary.headline: Saturn in the Planetary Terms
summary.text: Astrological delineations of Saturn placed in the terms of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus, describing wealth, authority, family relations, health, marriage, offspring, and the modifying effects of fortunes and malefics.
